en: Hello again. We just got back from the lake.
zh: 又见面啦。我们刚从湖边回来。

en: and it was literally such a breath of fresh air.
zh: 真的感觉像是呼吸到了一口新鲜空气。

en: We're both city folks, so I feel like we're both kind of used to breathing in a lot of smog.
zh: 我们俩都是城里人，所以感觉都已经有点习惯吸各种雾霾了。

en: The oxygen out here feels like high definition.
zh: 这里的氧气感觉像高清版一样。

en: But we got to see a bunch of wildlife, water, ducks.
zh: 不过我们看到了好多小动物，还有湖水、鸭子。

en: What more could you ask for?
zh: 还能要求什么呢？

en: But as you can kind of see now.
zh: 不过你们现在也能看出来。

en: sun's setting and we're getting a little bit peckish so it's time for dinner.
zh: 太阳快落山了，我们也有点饿了，所以该吃晚饭了。

en: Right over here we have some thinly shaved beef along with a Japanese cucumber,
zh: 这边有一些薄切牛肉，还有一根日式黄瓜，

en: an onion, sugar, soy sauce, sake, and mirin.
zh: 一个洋葱、糖、酱油、清酒和味醂。

en: And also this jar is full of dashi.
zh: 还有这个罐子里装满了高汤。

en: And when you see all those ingredients together, that means gyudon.
zh: 当你看到这些食材放在一起，就说明要做牛丼了。

en: And also gonna make a little cucumber salad to freshen it up a little bit.
zh: 我还打算做一点黄瓜沙拉，让整体更清爽一点。

en: Add some green.
zh: 加点绿色。

en: Let's start over here at the stove first.
zh: 我们先从炉灶这边开始。

en: We're gonna make our sauce mixture.
zh: 先来调一个酱汁。

en: Our soy sauce.
zh: 先加酱油。

en: Gonna do like one, two, three.
zh: 我大概倒一、二、三下。

en: Something like that.
zh: 差不多这样。

en: Kind of enough to cover the base of the pan.
zh: 差不多能铺满锅底就行。

en: Sake. I'm gonna go for about one, two.
zh: 清酒。我大概倒一、二下。

en: Mirin. Also about a one, two.
zh: 味醂。也大概一、二下。

en: Think I'm actually gonna do a little more soy sauce.
zh: 我觉得其实还要再加一点酱油。

en: A little more.
zh: 再多一点。

en: And then sugar, kind of optional.
zh: 然后是糖，这个可加可不加。

en: but I kind of like things a little bit sweet.
zh: 不过我个人比较喜欢带一点甜味。

en: There we go.
zh: 好了。

en: And right here we have some dashi.
zh: 这边是一些高汤。

en: It's really full.
zh: 装得特别满。

en: I only want about half of it.
zh: 我只想用大概一半。

en: That should be good.
zh: 这样应该就差不多了。

en: That was a little bit over, but that's okay.
zh: 稍微倒多了一点，不过没关系。

en: And then get that heat on.
zh: 然后开火。

en: I'm gonna go for about a medium.
zh: 我会调到差不多中火。

en: just until it goes to a simmer.
zh: 煮到微微沸腾就行。

en: And I'm also gonna add these onions.
zh: 我还要把这些洋葱加进去。

en: This is about a half onion.
zh: 这里大概是半个洋葱。

en: I usually like to use about a full onion.
zh: 我平时一般喜欢用差不多一整个洋葱。

en: but wifey's not much of a fan of onions, so this is compromise.
zh: 但我女朋友不是很爱吃洋葱，所以这就是我们的折中方案。

en: Spread that over.
zh: 把它铺开。

en: And we'll just let that come up to a simmer.
zh: 然后让它慢慢煮到微微沸腾。

en: In the meantime, let's see what this cucumber salad's talking about.
zh: 与此同时，我们来看看这个黄瓜沙拉怎么做。

en: No fancy shades for the cucumber.
zh: 黄瓜不用切什么花哨的形状。

en: Just cut them straight into these little circles.
zh: 直接切成这种小圆片就行。

en: And I'm gonna transfer them all into this steel bowl.
zh: 然后我把它们全部倒进这个钢盆里。

en: And since cucumbers are so dense in water.
zh: 因为黄瓜含水量特别高。

en: I'm gonna try to extract some of it by sprinkling some sea salt over it.
zh: 所以我会撒一点海盐，尽量把里面的水分逼出来一些。

en: Careful not to do too much, or else they will turn out very salty.
zh: 注意别撒太多，不然最后会特别咸。

en: Just a small sprinkle like that.
zh: 像这样轻轻撒一点就行。

en: And you just go in with your hands.
zh: 然后直接用手抓拌。

en: make sure they're all evenly covered.
zh: 确保每一片都均匀裹上盐。

en: Something like that.
zh: 差不多这样。

en: And now we need to let these rest for about 10 minutes to let that salt do its work.
zh: 现在要让它们静置大概10分钟，让盐发挥作用。

en: and get rid of some of that water.
zh: 把一部分水分带出来。

en: Let's go back to the stove.
zh: 我们回到炉灶这边。

en: It's just been a few minutes now.
zh: 现在才过了几分钟。

en: Let some of that sake burn off.
zh: 让里面的一些清酒挥发掉。

en: And then now we can go on top with our shaved beef.
zh: 然后现在可以把薄切牛肉铺上去了。

en: Just cover the pan.
zh: 把锅面盖满。

en: We'll keep that on a simmer.
zh: 继续保持微微沸腾的状态。

en: And then just add a lid.
zh: 然后盖上盖子。

en: Turn the temperature down a little bit.
zh: 把火调小一点。

en: And now you just leave it.
zh: 现在就放着让它煮。

en: Once all the meat turns brown and it absorbs a lot of that sauce,
zh: 等所有肉都变成棕色，并且吸收了很多酱汁之后，

en: then it's just ready.
zh: 就做好了。

en: Back to the cucumbers.
zh: 回到黄瓜这边。

en: All right, so you should see the cucumbers start to sweat a little bit.
zh: 好了，这时候你应该能看到黄瓜开始有点出水了。

en: They start glistening.
zh: 表面会开始变得亮晶晶的。

en: Now we just grab all of them and then just squeeze.
zh: 现在把它们全部抓起来，然后挤一挤。

en: And all that juice is gonna come out.
zh: 里面的汁水就会全部出来。

en: Try to drain as much of it as possible without damaging the cucumbers.
zh: 在不把黄瓜弄坏的前提下，尽量把水分挤干。

en: But if you do, that's okay.
zh: 不过如果弄坏了也没关系。

en: Unless you're like a Michelin star chef or anything.
zh: 除非你是什么米其林星级大厨之类的。

en: I'm sure whoever you're serving food would not mind.
zh: 我相信吃你做的东西的人应该不会介意。

en: And you wanna get all of them kind of looking like this.
zh: 你要让它们最后大概都变成这种样子。

en: Real floppy. That means that they're gonna take in whatever liquid you put in next.
zh: 软趴趴的。这就说明它们接下来会吸收你加进去的液体。

en: Now just run it under some cold water.
zh: 现在用冷水冲一下。

en: Wash out some of that salt.
zh: 把一部分盐洗掉。

en: Maybe one more good squeeze.
zh: 可能再用力挤最后一次。

en: All right, and we're ready.
zh: 好了，准备好了。

en: It's only been a few minutes now.
zh: 现在才过了几分钟。

en: Gonna check in on this.
zh: 来看看这边怎么样了。

en: Beautiful. All of our beef is nice and brown.
zh: 漂亮。所有牛肉都变成很好看的棕色了。

en: I see no pink.
zh: 看不到粉色了。

en: The onions look nice and translucent.
zh: 洋葱看起来也变得很通透。

en: This is ready.
zh: 这个已经好了。

en: Cover that up for now until our cucumber salad is done.
zh: 先盖起来，等黄瓜沙拉做好。

en: So right here I got some rice vinegar and sesame oil.
zh: 这边我准备了米醋和芝麻油。

en: This is my own rice vinegar that I brought.
zh: 这个米醋是我自己带来的。

en: But this sesame oil was in the pantry of the B&B.
zh: 但这个芝麻油是民宿储物柜里的。

en: And the Best Buy date is like completely rubbed off.
zh: 而且最佳食用日期已经完全被磨掉了。

en: but I can just assume it's like grandma pantry's old.
zh: 不过我猜它大概就是那种奶奶家储物柜里放了很久的东西。

en: But if anybody can let me know if sesame oil actually like expires,
zh: 如果有人知道芝麻油到底会不会过期，

en: that would be appreciated.
zh: 麻烦告诉我一下。

en: Or I guess I can let you know if I got sick or not.
zh: 或者我也可以之后告诉你们我有没有吃坏肚子。

en: Untwist it. Passes the smell test, so that's a good sign.
zh: 拧开。闻起来没问题，所以这是个好迹象。

en: Just gonna go right over the top.
zh: 直接淋在上面。

en: Just a little bit.
zh: 一点点就行。

en: Followed by some rice vinegar.
zh: 然后加一点米醋。

en: Just a splash.
zh: 就倒一点。

en: Give that a good mix.
zh: 好好拌匀。

en: Sample an ugly one.
zh: 尝一片长得不太好看的。

en: That's pretty good.
zh: 挺不错的。

en: The flavors are emerging.
zh: 味道开始出来了。

en: I'm actually gonna add in a little bit of that gyudon sauce.
zh: 我其实打算再加一点牛丼的酱汁进去。

en: I think that'll add a nice pop.
zh: 我觉得这样会让味道更亮一点。

en: Some more sweetness, some more saltiness from that soy sauce.
zh: 能多一点甜味，也多一点酱油带来的咸香。

en: I think it'll be good.
zh: 我觉得会很好吃。

en: Just a real petite spoonful.
zh: 就加非常小的一勺。

en: Or three actually.
zh: 或者其实加三勺。

en: And the finishing touch, nice sprinkle of sesame seeds.
zh: 最后收尾，撒上一点漂亮的芝麻。

en: All right, try an ugly one.
zh: 好了，再尝一片长得不太好看的。

en: Needs a touch more sesame oil.
zh: 还需要再来一点点芝麻油。

en: Splash more rice vinegar.
zh: 再加一点米醋。

en: And honestly, a little bit of sweetener.
zh: 说实话，还需要加一点甜味剂。

en: Light soy sauce.
zh: 淡口酱油。

en: A little bit saltier and lighter than dark soy sauce.
zh: 它比老抽更咸一点，颜色也更浅。

en: That's money. Okay, I think we're just about done.
zh: 这味道绝了。好了，我觉得我们差不多完成了。

en: Actually, last step, the rice.
zh: 其实还有最后一步，米饭。

en: I did not bring my rice cooker on this trip, so.
zh: 这次旅行我没有带电饭煲，所以，

en: this instant rice is a big help.
zh: 这种即食米饭真的帮大忙了。

en: Open up a little corner.
zh: 打开一个小角。

en: And this is actually a microwave.
zh: 而且这其实是一个微波炉。

en: Feel like Tony Stark.
zh: 感觉自己像 Tony Stark。

en: Close that up.
zh: 把它关上。

en: And I'm gonna go about a minute.
zh: 我大概加热一分钟。

en: Always wanted a microwave like that.
zh: 我一直都想要一个这样的微波炉。

en: This is fulfilling that dream.
zh: 这算是圆梦了。

en: So I obviously wasn't able to take my whole ceramic collection on the road trip,
zh: 显然我不可能把我的整套陶瓷收藏都带上公路旅行，

en: but luckily, this B&B owner has some pretty decent taste.
zh: 不过幸运的是，这家民宿的房东审美还挺不错。

en: These bowls are pretty cool.
zh: 这些碗还挺好看的。

en: I'm gonna use these.
zh: 我就用这些。

en: Here are our trays of the day.
zh: 这就是我们今天的餐盘。

en: Our gyudon. Mine's the one with a bunch of onion.
zh: 我们的牛丼。我这份是有很多洋葱的。

en: Cucumber salad. She likes that bowl.
zh: 黄瓜沙拉。她喜欢那个碗。

en: And I like this one.
zh: 我喜欢这个。

en: Let's get a little more sauce on there.
zh: 再往上面多浇一点酱汁。

en: Listen it up.
zh: 让它更湿润一点。

en: And I think we have enough time for one finishing touch.
zh: 我觉得我们还有时间做一个最后的点缀。

en: Perfect.
zh: 完美。
